invoiceLines.description: EN 16931 invoice lines (BG-25). Each line carries lineId (BT-126), quantity (BT-129), unitCode (BT-130), netAmount (BT-131), itemName (BT-153), netPrice (BT-146), vatCategory (BT-151), vatRate (BT-152) and optional line-level allowances/charges (BG-27/BG-28).

unitCode.description: Invoiced quantity unit of measure (BT-130), UN/ECE Recommendation 20.

vatCategory.description: Invoiced item VAT category code (BT-151), UNTDID 5305.

vatRate.description: Invoiced item VAT rate (BT-152); >0 for Standard rated, 0 for the zero/exempt families, absent for 'Not subject to VAT'.

lineAllowances.description: Invoice line allowances (BG-27); each carries amount (BT-136), baseAmount (BT-137) and a reasonText (BT-139) or reasonCode (BT-140).

lineCharges.description: Invoice line charges (BG-28); each carries amount (BT-141), baseAmount (BT-142) and a reasonText (BT-144) or reasonCode (BT-145).

vatBreakdown.description: EN 16931 VAT breakdown groups (BG-23). Each group carries category (BT-118), taxableAmount (BT-116), taxAmount (BT-117), rate (BT-119) and exemptionReasonText/Code (BT-120/BT-121).

rate.description: VAT category rate (BT-119); absent only for category 'O' (not subject to VAT).

exemptionReasonCode.description: VAT exemption reason code (BT-121); present for exempt/reverse-charge/export/intra-community/not-subject, absent for Standard/Zero rated.

allowances.description: EN 16931 document-level allowances (BG-20); each carries amount (BT-92), baseAmount (BT-93), vatCategory (BT-95) and a reasonText (BT-97) or reasonCode (BT-98).

vatCategory.description: Document level allowance VAT category code (BT-95).

charges.description: EN 16931 document-level charges (BG-21); each carries amount (BT-99), baseAmount (BT-100), vatCategory (BT-102) and a reasonText (BT-104) or reasonCode (BT-105).

vatCategory.description: Document level charge VAT category code (BT-102).

allowancesTotal.description: Sum of allowances on document level (BT-107) = Σ allowances[].amount.

chargesTotal.description: Sum of charges on document level (BT-108) = Σ charges[].amount.

lineNetTotal.description: Sum of Invoice line net amount (BT-106) = Σ invoiceLines[].netAmount.
